name: bandwave
description: Live music visualizer for the macOS desktop
author: Bandwave

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Bandwave listens to what your Mac is playing to draw the visualizer. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: On macOS before 14.2 Bandwave listens through the microphone to draw the visualizer. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: macOS grants system audio together with screen capture. Bandwave only uses the audio.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Bandwave asks Spotify or Music what is playing and sends play / pause / skip.
